examples.ko: 밤새 광풍이 불어서 잠을 못 잤어요.
examples.en: A violent wind blew all night, so I couldn't sleep.
The roof was blown away by the fierce wind.
The boats came back to port to avoid the storm winds.
The fierce wind didn't die down until dawn.

examples.ko: 부동산 광풍 속에서 집값이 크게 올랐어요.
examples.en: Housing prices rose sharply amid the property frenzy.
That song swept across the country like a storm.

explain: 몹시 사납게 부는 바람이에요. 일상에서 바람이 센 날은 '강풍'이나 '바람이 세다'라고 하고, '광풍'은 더 거칠고 글 같은 느낌이에요. 뉴스에서는 '투자 광풍'처럼 사회가 한쪽으로 휩쓸리는 모습을 비유할 때도 써요.

phrases.en: A raging wind blew all night.
phrases.nuance_ko: 바람이 거세게 계속 불어닥친다는 느낌을 줘요.
phrases.nuance_en: Gives the sense of a fierce wind that keeps battering.

phrases.example: 오늘은 강풍 때문에 비행기가 늦게 떠요.
phrases.en: Because of strong winds, the flight leaves late today.
phrases.nuance_ko: 일기예보나 일상에서는 '광풍'보다 '강풍'을 더 자연스럽게 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: In weather reports and daily talk, 'gangpung' sounds more natural than 'gwangpung'.

phrases.example: 몇 년 전에 코인 투자 광풍이 불었어요.
phrases.en: A cryptocurrency investment frenzy swept through a few years ago.
phrases.nuance_ko: 사회가 한쪽으로 휩쓸리는 현상을 바람에 빗대어 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Compares a society-wide rush in one direction to a wild wind.

explain_en: It means a wind that blows extremely fiercely. In daily life people say '강풍' or '바람이 세다' for a windy day, while '광풍' sounds rougher and more literary. In the news it is also used figuratively, as in '투자 광풍' (investment frenzy), when society gets swept in one direction.

examples.en: A thunderous noise came as the plane passed.
I suddenly heard a deafening noise and looked out the window.
A motorcycle roared down the alley.

examples.ko: 공사장에서 굉음이 계속 나서 너무 시끄러워요.
examples.en: Loud booming noises keep coming from the construction site, so it's very noisy.
The thunder rumbled like a roar and the child cried.
The train entered the tunnel with a roar.

explain: 그냥 큰 소리가 아니라 기계, 폭발, 천둥처럼 크게 울리는 소리에 어울려요. '굉음이 나다', '굉음을 내다', '굉음이 울리다'로 자주 말해요. 사람 목소리에는 보통 쓰지 않아요.

phrases.en: A motorcycle passed by with a roar.
phrases.nuance_ko: 기계나 차가 크게 울리는 소리를 낼 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when a machine or vehicle makes a booming sound.

phrases.en: A roar echoed from the construction site.
phrases.nuance_ko: 큰 소리가 멀리까지 울릴 때 어울려요.
phrases.nuance_en: Fits a loud sound that echoes far.

phrases.en: I was startled by the tremendous roar.
phrases.nuance_ko: 소리가 얼마나 큰지 강조할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used to stress how loud the sound is.

explain_en: It is not just any loud sound but a booming, resonant one like machines, explosions or thunder. Common patterns are '굉음이 나다', '굉음을 내다' and '굉음이 울리다'. It is not normally used for a person's voice.

examples.en: A sparrow walks along, wagging its tail.
A peacock's tail is truly magnificent.

examples.ko: 그 새는 꽁지에 하얀 털이 있어요.
examples.en: That bird has white feathers on its tail.
The chicken hid in the grass with only its tail showing.

examples.ko: 새가 꽁지로 균형을 잡으며 나뭇가지에 앉았어요.
examples.en: The bird landed on the branch, balancing with its tail.
I saw a long-tailed bird in the park.

explain: 새의 꼬리 쪽 깃털을 말해요. 강아지나 고양이 같은 동물에게는 '꼬리'를 써요.

phrases.example: 저 새는 꽁지가 길어서 눈에 잘 띄어요.
phrases.en: That bird has a long tail, so it stands out.
phrases.nuance_ko: 새의 생김새를 말할 때 쓰는 가장 기본적인 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The most basic phrase for describing a bird's looks.

phrases.en: The peacock spread its tail wide.
phrases.nuance_ko: 새가 꼬리깃을 펼치는 모습을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for a bird fanning out its tail feathers.

phrases.en: This bird's tail feathers are blue.
phrases.nuance_ko: '꽁지'에 '깃(깃털)'이 붙어 꼬리 쪽 깃털만 가리켜요.
phrases.nuance_en: Adding 깃 (feather) to 꽁지 refers specifically to the tail feathers.

explain_en: It refers to the tail feathers of a bird. For animals like dogs and cats, use '꼬리'.

examples.en: It's March, but it's still chilly because of the spring cold wind.
The chilly spring wind blew, so I took my scarf out again.
The cherry blossom petals are fluttering in the chilly spring wind.
The chilly flowering-season wind visits briefly in early spring.
I walked to school in the chilly spring wind.
Even in the chilly wind, the plum blossoms bloomed beautifully.

explain: 꽃이 필 무렵 이른 봄에 부는 쌀쌀한 바람이에요. 비슷한 시기의 추위를 가리키는 '꽃샘추위'와 함께 날씨 이야기에서 들을 수 있어요.

phrases.en: The cherry blossoms bloomed late because of the cold snap.
phrases.nuance_ko: 바람이 아니라 이른 봄에 잠깐 다시 추워지는 날씨 전체를 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Refers to the whole late-winter cold spell, not just the wind.

phrases.en: A chilly spring wind is blowing, so my hands are cold.
phrases.nuance_ko: '불다'와 함께 써서 지금 바람이 분다고 말할 때 자연스러워요.
phrases.nuance_en: Natural with 불다 when saying the wind is blowing now.

phrases.en: I waited for the bus, shivering in the chilly wind.
phrases.nuance_ko: 조사 '에'를 붙여 바람 때문에 춥다는 쓰임으로 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: With the particle 에, it shows being cold because of the wind.

explain_en: It is the chilly wind that blows in early spring around the time flowers bloom. You can hear it in weather talk along with '꽃샘추위', which refers to the cold of the same season.

examples.en: The waves roll in, swelling and falling.
The river flows with big, soft swells.
The barley field ripples in the wind.

examples.ko: 물이 넘실넘실 찬 컵을 조심히 옮겼어요.
examples.en: I carefully carried the cup, brimming with water.
A big ship drifts on the rolling sea.
In the autumn fields, the rice waves in great ripples.

explain: 물결이나 곡식이 크고 부드럽게 일렁이는 모양이에요. 뒤에 '흐르다, 흔들리다, 물결치다' 같은 동사가 잘 와요. '출렁출렁'보다 물이 가득 차서 크게 움직이는 느낌이 있어요.

phrases.en: The big river flows in rolling waves.
phrases.nuance_ko: 물이 가득 차서 크게 흐르는 모습에 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for water flowing broadly and fully.

phrases.en: The sea ripples in big, soft waves.
phrases.nuance_ko: 물결이 부드럽고 크게 이는 모습을 강조해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Emphasizes waves rising softly and widely.

phrases.en: The barley field ripples in the wind.
phrases.nuance_ko: 곡식이 바람에 물결처럼 흔들리는 모습에도 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Also used for crops waving like water in the wind.

explain_en: It describes water or crops moving in big, soft swells. Verbs like '흐르다', '흔들리다' and '물결치다' often follow. Compared with '출렁출렁', it feels fuller, as if the water is brimming.

examples.ko: 올해 벚꽃 만개는 예상보다 일주일 빨라요.
examples.en: This year's cherry blossom full bloom is a week earlier than expected.

examples.ko: 꽃이 만개 직전이라 일주일 뒤에 가면 좋아요.
examples.en: The flowers are just before full bloom, so going in a week would be good.

examples.ko: 만개 시기에는 사람이 너무 많아서 걷기도 힘들어요.
examples.en: At peak bloom there are so many people that even walking is hard.

examples.ko: 남쪽에서 봄꽃의 만개 소식이 올라오고 있어요.
examples.en: News of spring flowers in full bloom is coming up from the south.

examples.ko: 매화의 만개를 기다리며 매일 공원에 가요.
examples.en: I go to the park every day waiting for the plum blossoms to be in full bloom.
We took a family photo in a rose garden in full bloom.

explain: 봄 날씨 뉴스에서 '개화'는 꽃이 피기 시작하는 때, 만개는 꽃이 활짝 핀 때라서 둘을 나눠서 말해요. 일상 대화에서는 '활짝 피었어요'가 더 자연스러워요.

phrases.en: I checked the cherry blossom full-bloom time in advance.
phrases.nuance_ko: 꽃이 활짝 피는 때를 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for the time when flowers are fully open.

phrases.en: The flowers are about to reach full bloom.
phrases.nuance_ko: 곧 활짝 필 때 쓰는 표현이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when flowers are about to open fully.

phrases.en: Flowers have bloomed fully in the park.
phrases.nuance_ko: 일상 대화에서는 '만개'보다 이 말이 자연스러워요.
phrases.nuance_en: More natural than '만개' in everyday conversation.

explain_en: In spring weather news, '개화' is when flowers begin to open and 만개 is when they are fully open, so the two are told apart. In everyday talk, '활짝 피었어요' sounds more natural.

examples.ko: 봄이 되자 개울가 버들에 새잎이 났어요.
examples.en: When spring came, new leaves grew on the willows by the stream.
By the stream, the willow sways gently in the wind.

examples.ko: 연못 옆에 버들 한 그루가 서 있어요.
examples.en: A willow tree stands next to the pond.
The children made a whistle from willow branches.

examples.ko: 강가에 버들이 줄지어 서 있어서 풍경이 예뻐요.
examples.en: Willows stand in a row along the river, so the scenery is pretty.
A single willow leaf fell onto the water.

explain: 일상에서는 '버드나무'라고 말하는 경우가 많고, 버들은 시나 노래, '버들가지', '버들잎' 같은 말에서 자주 보여요. 가지가 길게 늘어진 나무는 '수양버들'이라고 해요. 부드럽고 가는 느낌을 줘서 글에서 풍경을 그릴 때 어울려요.

phrases.en: The willow branches sway gently in the spring breeze.
phrases.nuance_ko: 버들의 가늘고 긴 가지를 가리키는 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Refers to the thin, long branches of a willow.

phrases.en: A willow leaf fell onto the pond.
phrases.nuance_ko: 버들의 잎을 가리킬 때 쓰는 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A pairing that refers to willow leaves.

phrases.en: Weeping willows stand in a row along the river.
phrases.nuance_ko: 가지가 길게 늘어지는 버들의 종류예요.
phrases.nuance_en: A kind of willow with long drooping branches.

explain_en: In daily life people often say '버드나무', while 버들 shows up in poems, songs and words like '버들가지' (willow branch) and '버들잎' (willow leaf). The kind with long hanging branches is called '수양버들' (weeping willow). It gives a soft, slender feel, so it suits descriptions of scenery in writing.

examples.en: A gentle breeze blows in through the window.
The spring breeze lightly brushing past feels nice.
The puppy gave its tail a light wag.
I saw the curtain sway gently.
My hair fluttered lightly, so I brushed it back with my hand.

examples.ko: 저녁이 되자 선선한 바람이 살랑 불기 시작했어요.
examples.en: When evening came, a cool breeze began to blow gently.

explain: 센 바람이 아니라 부드러운 바람이나 가벼운 흔들림에 써요. 말할 때는 '살랑살랑'처럼 반복해서 쓰는 경우가 많아요.

phrases.en: The leaves are swaying lightly.
phrases.nuance_ko: '살랑'을 반복한 모양으로, 말할 때 더 자주 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: The repeated form of '살랑', used more often in speech.

phrases.en: The puppy wagged its tail lightly.
phrases.nuance_ko: 동물이 기분 좋게 꼬리를 가볍게 흔드는 모습에 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Describes an animal softly wagging its tail happily.

phrases.en: Her skirt hem flutters lightly in the wind.
phrases.nuance_ko: 가벼운 옷이 부드럽게 움직이는 모습에 어울려요.
phrases.nuance_en: Fits light clothing moving softly in the breeze.

explain_en: It is used for soft breezes or light swaying, not strong wind. In speech, people often repeat it as '살랑살랑'.

examples.ko: 죽은 줄 알았던 화분이 비를 맞고 소생했어요.
examples.en: The pot plant I thought was dead revived in the rain.
When spring comes, all of nature comes back to life.

examples.ko: 쓰러졌던 환자가 응급 치료로 소생해서 의사들이 기뻐했어요.
examples.en: The patient who had collapsed was revived by emergency treatment, and the doctors were glad.

examples.ko: 다친 새가 소생하길 바라며 따뜻하게 해 줬어요.
examples.en: I kept the injured bird warm, hoping it would revive.

examples.ko: 도시 경제가 소생하는 데 몇 년이 걸렸어요.
examples.en: It took several years for the city's economy to revive.
New leaves came out on the tree that revived.

explain: 죽은 듯하던 사람, 식물, 자연이 다시 살아날 때 써요. 글이나 뉴스에서 더 자주 보여요. 아팠던 사람이 기운을 되찾는 정도라면 '회복하다'가 자연스러워요.

phrases.en: When it rained, the withered grass came back to life.
phrases.nuance_ko: 뜻이 비슷하지만 더 쉬워서 일상 대화에서 자연스럽게 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Similar in meaning but easier, and natural in everyday talk.

phrases.en: The doctor revived the person who had collapsed.
phrases.nuance_ko: 다시 살아나게 만드는 행동을 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Describes the action of bringing something back to life.

phrases.example: 이 화분은 물을 주면 소생할 수 있어요.
phrases.en: This plant can revive if you water it.
phrases.nuance_ko: 다시 살아날 가능성을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used to talk about the possibility of coming back to life.

explain_en: Use it when something that seemed dead, such as a person, a plant or nature, comes back to life. It appears more in writing and the news. If a sick person merely regains strength, 회복하다 sounds more natural.

dis.h: recover from near death; formal, written

p.n: 살아나다 is the everyday way to say it; 소생하다 sounds literary.

examples.en: When May came, the mountains filled with fresh green.
I walked along a forest path thick with fresh greenery.

examples.ko: 비가 온 뒤라 신록이 더 싱그러워요.
examples.en: It rained, so the fresh green looks even more vibrant.
Looking at the fresh green outside the window calms my mind.
I want to travel in the season of fresh green leaves.
In every park the fresh green shines dazzlingly.

explain: 봄이 끝나고 초여름으로 가며 새로 난 잎이 푸르게 올라온 모습을 말해요. 가을의 '단풍'과 짝처럼 계절 느낌을 줘서 글이나 인사말에서 자주 나와요.

phrases.en: May is the season of fresh green leaves.
phrases.nuance_ko: 초여름 무렵을 아름답게 말할 때 쓰는 표현이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A lovely way to refer to early summer.

phrases.en: The fresh green gets deeper day by day.
phrases.nuance_ko: 잎의 초록색이 점점 진해지는 모습을 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Describes the green of the leaves getting deeper.

phrases.en: I enjoyed the fresh greenery in the park on the weekend.
phrases.nuance_ko: 산책이나 소풍에서 푸른 잎을 보며 즐길 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when enjoying green leaves on a walk or picnic.

explain_en: It describes the fresh new leaves turning bright green as spring moves into early summer. It pairs in feeling with autumn's '단풍' and often appears in writing and seasonal greetings.

examples.ko: 산 정상에 넓은 억새밭이 펼쳐져 있어요.
examples.en: A wide field of silver grass stretches out at the mountain top.
Last weekend we took a family photo in the silver grass field.

examples.ko: 바람이 불자 억새밭이 은빛 물결처럼 일렁였어요.
examples.en: When the wind blew, the field rippled like silver waves.

examples.ko: 억새밭 사이로 좁은 길이 나 있어요.
examples.en: A narrow path runs through the silver grass field.
Every autumn, people flock to see the silver grass fields.
There is a small cafe near the silver grass field.

explain: 억새가 넓게 자란 곳을 말해요. 가을 나들이나 여행 이야기에서 '억새밭이 펼쳐지다', '억새밭을 걷다'처럼 자주 써요. 억새를 보러 가는 곳이 많아서 가을이면 안내문에도 나와요.

phrases.en: I walked through the silver grass field with my family.
phrases.nuance_ko: 억새가 가득한 길을 산책할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when taking a walk through a field full of silver grass.
phrases.en_equiv: to walk through a silver grass field

phrases.en: I want to go to a silver grass field in autumn.
phrases.nuance_ko: 장소로 가는 계획을 말할 때 조사 '에'를 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Uses the particle 에 to talk about plans to go there.
phrases.en_equiv: to go to a silver grass field

phrases.en: I walked slowly along the path through the silver grass.
phrases.nuance_ko: 억새밭 사이로 난 길을 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Refers to a path running through the silver grass field.

explain_en: It refers to a place where silver grass grows over a wide area. In stories about autumn outings and trips, you often hear '억새밭이 펼쳐지다' and '억새밭을 걷다'. Many places are visited just to see silver grass, so the word often appears on notices in autumn.

examples.ko: 아침 해가 바다 위로 찬란히 떠올랐어요.
examples.en: The morning sun rose radiantly over the sea.
The stars shine brilliantly in the night sky.

examples.ko: 이 도시는 오래전에 찬란히 꽃핀 문화를 가졌어요.
examples.en: This city had a culture that bloomed magnificently long ago.
The chandelier sparkled brilliantly from the ceiling.
His name remained in history with glory.

examples.ko: 졸업하는 날 아침 해가 찬란히 빛났어요.
examples.en: On graduation day, the morning sun shone brilliantly.

explain: 눈부시게 빛나는 모습이나, 훌륭하고 화려한 역사·문화를 말할 때 써요. 일상 대화에서 가볍게 쓰기보다 글이나 감동적인 장면에서 많이 보여요. 형용사는 '찬란하다'예요.

phrases.en: The sunlight pours down brilliantly.
phrases.nuance_ko: '찬란히'와 뜻이 같고, 문장에서 동사 앞에 자연스럽게 이어져요.
phrases.nuance_en: Same meaning as 찬란히, flowing naturally before a verb.

phrases.en: We took photos under the dazzling sunshine.
phrases.nuance_ko: 형용사 '찬란하다'를 명사 앞에 붙인 형태예요.
phrases.nuance_en: The adjective form placed before a noun.

phrases.en: Korea has many splendid cultural heritage sites.
phrases.nuance_ko: 훌륭하고 화려한 역사나 문화를 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for a magnificent history or culture.

explain_en: It describes something shining dazzlingly, or a splendid history or culture. It appears more in writing and moving scenes than in light everyday talk. The adjective form is '찬란하다'.

examples.en: When the power went out, the room became pitch dark.

examples.ko: 칠흑 같은 밤길을 혼자 걸으니 무서웠어요.
examples.en: Walking alone on the pitch-dark night road was scary.

examples.ko: 할머니는 젊을 때 칠흑 같은 머리카락이 아름다웠대요.
examples.en: They say my grandmother's jet-black hair was beautiful when she was young.

examples.ko: 산속은 칠흑 같은 어둠에 싸여 있었어요.
examples.en: The mountains were wrapped in pitch-black darkness.
There was no moon, so the sky was jet-black.

examples.ko: 칠흑 속에서 작은 불빛이 하나 보였어요.
examples.en: A small light appeared in the pitch darkness.

explain: 거의 '칠흑 같은 어둠/밤', '칠흑같이 어둡다'처럼 굳은 짝으로 써요. 머리카락이나 눈동자가 아주 까만 것도 비유로 말해요. 일상 대화에서는 '깜깜하다', '캄캄하다'가 더 가벼운 말이에요.

phrases.example: 칠흑 같은 어둠 속에서 길을 찾기 어려웠어요.
phrases.en: It was hard to find the way in the pitch-black darkness.
phrases.nuance_ko: 아주 깊은 어둠을 말하는 가장 흔한 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The most common pairing for very deep darkness.

phrases.example: 그 배우는 칠흑 같은 머리카락이 예뻐요.
phrases.en: That actor's jet-black hair is pretty.
phrases.nuance_ko: 아주 새까만 머리카락을 비유로 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used figuratively for very black hair.

phrases.en: The room was dark, so I turned on the light.
phrases.nuance_ko: 칠흑보다 가볍고 일상에서 자주 쓰는 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A lighter, everyday word compared with 칠흑.

explain_en: It is mostly used in fixed pairings such as '칠흑 같은 어둠/밤' and '칠흑같이 어둡다'. It can also describe very black hair or eyes figuratively. In everyday talk, '깜깜하다' and '캄캄하다' are the lighter words.

examples.en: My ears were numb in the icy wind of the winter morning.
An icy wind is blowing, so I don't want to go out.
When I went out to the Han River, the wind was really biting.
I waited for the bus in the biting wind.

examples.ko: 오늘은 칼바람 때문에 체감온도가 더 낮아요.
examples.en: Today the felt temperature is lower because of the icy wind.

examples.ko: 이럴 땐 목도리로 칼바람을 막아야 해요.
examples.en: At times like this you have to block the icy wind with a scarf.

explain: '찬바람'보다 훨씬 날카롭게 살을 에는 듯한 겨울바람에 써요. 보통 '칼바람이 불다/몰아치다'라고 해요. 글에서는 '삭풍'이라는 말도 있지만 대화에서는 '칼바람'이 더 가까운 말이에요.

phrases.en: A bitter wind is blowing today, so it's freezing.
phrases.nuance_ko: '칼바람'과 가장 자주 함께 쓰는 동사예요.
phrases.nuance_en: The verb most often paired with 칼바람.

phrases.en: An icy wind lashed the mountaintop.
phrases.nuance_ko: 바람이 세게 계속 불 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when the wind blows strongly and continuously.

phrases.en: Cold wind is coming in through the window.
phrases.nuance_ko: '칼바람'보다 덜 날카로운, 일반적으로 차가운 바람이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A milder, more general cold wind than 칼바람.

explain_en: It is used for a winter wind that feels sharper than a plain '찬바람' and cuts into the skin. You usually say '칼바람이 불다/몰아치다'. There is also the literary word '삭풍', but '칼바람' is closer to everyday speech.
